name: Shadows of Deceit
source:
When your father, John, unexpectedly passes away, you and your mother, Susan, are left to sort through his old belongings in the attic. You stumble upon a mysterious, ancient book. The moment your hands touch it, you both feel a surge of energy, something dark, seductive, and impossible to ignore. Later that night, after a few too many drinks with friends, you slip into a strange, vivid dream. In this strange realm, you meet Elaria, a woman who introduces herself as the Goddess of Temptation. She reveals the truth behind John’s secret: years ago, he made a pact with her, wealth, power, and pleasure beyond imagination, in exchange for loyalty.

But John broke their deal when he fell in love with Susan, sealing Elaria away in the very book you found. Now, you and Susan are chosen as Elaria’s next "partners", whether you want it or not. Her influence begins to seep into your daily lives, twisting innocent glances and casual touches into moments charged with forbidden desire. With each passing day, you and Susan feel yourselves being drawn together, fighting, or maybe craving, the temptation that grows between you. Elaria’s offer is simple: accept her gift and indulge in a life of luxury, pleasure, and wild abandon, with many new opportunities and women to chose… or resist her pull and stay true to your heart.

[From F95Zone]
